findings.problem: For to think in the sense of giving your opinion, denken, glauben and finden are all common right answers (Was denkst du? Ich glaube schon. Ich finde, ...), and the hint does not rule them out.
findings.fix: hint: give your opinion, as in Was ___st du? (what do you reckon?); not denken, glauben or finden

back.target: to think, to reckon, to be of the opinion (also: to mean)
back.example: I think we should go now. (also readable as: I mean, we should go now.)

note: Ich meine, ... at the start of a sentence can also be heard as the filler I mean, so an example like Was meinst du dazu? (What do you think about it?) would show the opinion sense more clearly.
